files.operations.sop:
@op.ui.shell.openTab core.operation
    impl=openTab
    semantics=action
    action=ui.openTab
    doc="Makes a tab the active tab (remembers the previous one). Also the documented cross-world request other tool worlds use to bring their tab forward: ctx.request(\"ui.openTab\", { tab })."

@op.ui.shell.playGame core.operation
    impl=playGame
    semantics=action
    action=ui.playGame
    doc="Opens a game tab and starts a game there through the game world (ctx.request)."

@op.ui.shell.chooseGame core.operation
    impl=chooseGame
    semantics=action
    action=ui.chooseGame
    doc="Lists the games that can be played."

@op.ui.shell.back core.operation
    impl=back
    semantics=action
    action=ui.back
    doc="Returns to the previous tab."

@op.ui.shell.whichTab core.operation
    impl=whichTab
    semantics=action
    action=ui.whichTab
    doc="Says which tab is open."

@op.ui.shell.speaker core.operation
    impl=speaker
    semantics=action
    action=ui.speaker
    doc="Turns the speaker on or off (effect speech.cancel when turned off)."

@op.ui.shell.listening core.operation
    impl=listening
    semantics=action
    action=ui.listening
    doc="Turns the microphone listening on or off."

@op.ui.shell.handsFree core.operation
    impl=handsFree
    semantics=action
    action=ui.handsFree
    doc="Turns hands-free mode on (which also starts listening) or off (which also stops listening)."

@op.ui.shell.rate core.operation
    impl=rate
    semantics=action
    action=ui.rate
    doc="Makes the speech slower or faster by 0.25 (range 0.5 to 2) or sets it to a value."

@op.ui.shell.language core.operation
    impl=language
    semantics=action
    action=ui.language
    doc="Sets the interface, recognition and speech language (en or ro)."

@op.ui.shell.newGame core.operation
    impl=newGame
    semantics=action
    action=ui.newGame
    doc="Starts a new game in the game of the active tab (ctx.request)."

@op.ui.shell.giveUp core.operation
    impl=giveUp
    semantics=action
    action=ui.giveUp
    doc="Gives up the game of the active tab (ctx.request)."

@op.ui.shell.hint core.operation
    impl=hint
    semantics=action
    action=ui.hint
    doc="Asks the game of the active tab for a hint (ctx.request)."

@op.ui.shell.phraseLog core.operation
    impl=phraseLog
    semantics=action
    action=ui.phraseLog
    doc="Phrase log of the host (what the user typed or said, kept in the browser): shows it in Settings, exports it, or reports its size. Effect phraselog { what: show | export | count } is carried out by the host."

@op.ui.shell.settings core.operation
    impl=settings
    semantics=action
    action=ui.settings
    doc="Opens the host's Settings dialog (optionally on one tab: understanding, language, voice, phrases, models, developer, about) or closes it. Effect settings { action: open | close, tab } is carried out by the host."
